title: Eagle Kensington Chesterfield Bed – Diamond Tufted Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Eagle Kensington Chesterfield Bed is a Chesterfield bed with deep diamond button tufting across a tall 54-inch floor-standing headboard, matched by an equally well-finished footboard. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £384.99 in Single 3ft to £519.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Classic Chesterfield deep diamond button tufting
  • Matching upholstered headboard and footboard
  • 54" tall floor-standing headboard
  • Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille in a wide fabric colour selection
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £384.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £439.99
  • Double 4ft6: £454.99
  • King 5ft: £489.99
  • Super King 6ft: £519.99

Materials & build

Solid support base, handmade to order in our workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Upholstery is Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Storage

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call us on 07417 439197 to talk through the option and any price difference.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99. With a footboard, allow for it when you measure the room.

Customisation

Choose your fabric and colour, with free swatches so you can see them in person first.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the Royal Chesterfield Wingback Bed or the Chesterfield Tufted Bed, browse Chesterfield beds, and read the Chesterfield bed buying guide.

FAQ

What is a Chesterfield bed?

A Chesterfield bed has deep button tufting across the headboard. The Kensington uses classic diamond button tufting on a tall 54 inch headboard.

Does it have a footboard?

Yes, it comes with a matching upholstered footboard.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Yes. Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
